description: Source code implementing Vulkan debug report callback management, including callback registration, removal, message handling, and related utility functions within the vulkan::driver namespace.

classes.name: DebugReportCallbackList
classes.description: Manages a list of debug report callback nodes, allowing addition, removal, and message dispatch.

classes.name: DebugReportLogger
classes.description: Handles logging of debug report messages, including invoking callback functions.

methods.name: AddCallback
methods.description: Adds a new debug report callback to the list.

methods.name: RemoveCallback
methods.description: Removes a specified callback node from the list.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches a debug report message to registered callbacks.

methods.name: PrintV
methods.description: Formats and logs a message with variable arguments.
